owner: Agent Host exclusively owns the Connectors Rust worker; no forwarding Broker process

semantics.scope: Host accepts only the trusted Native projection and authoritative persisted snapshot, never renderer/Runtime-supplied scope. Product grant carrier remains disabled until separately implemented and qualified. ContextBinding.nativeThreadId is required nullable: null is new-thread intent, a string identifies an existing thread. New flow is prepare(null), thread/start with complete Gateway config, actual turn/start, then bind actual thread+turn once. Existing flow prepares the real thread, cold-resumes complete config, starts and binds. Binding never rewrites original context. At most one live bound lease per actual native thread.
semantics.clock: At prepare cap the monotonic deadline by requested TTL, remaining trusted Native authorization and 300000 ms. A fresh same-authority renew_market_scope on the exclusive Native/Host pipes updates only live prepared/bound market selections. Keep the original binding and requested TTL cap. A repeated or out-of-order sequence cannot move a deadline. Never recreate expired or revoked leases. A shortened proof bounds pending work and cancels existing execution permits. Every call retains its own approval and original deadline.
semantics.deduplication: Mutation operationId is process-local intent identity excluding transport requestId; compare the full typed payload before applying anything. Reserve each stable (ownerUserId, tenantId, nativeProcessEpoch, agentSessionId, actual turnOperationId) for one immutable selection lease. Authorization revision/expiry refresh never changes this reservation key. A changed scope binding must not modify the old record; renewed scope plus new mutation UUID cannot re-prepare the same original turn. Duplicate live prepare returns its original capability without deadline extension; expired/revoked prepare always fails closed, even with a new operationId. Decision replay returns a prior receipt without re-admission. No replay, provider poll or tool invocation can issue a new scope renewal.
semantics.capacity: Keep bounded original mutation receipts and reserved turn-operation tombstones for the worker lifetime. Do not evict them to accept new mutation work; capacity exhaustion fails closed. Active pending calls and retained leases must respect limits. If Revoke or Shutdown returns a typed capacity_exceeded error, Host MUST close this owner stdin normally and permanently retire its generation while still holding the serial control gate, then return that original typed capacity error. Host must subsequently call Close to observe normal exit or retain STOP_PENDING. Do not add a receipt, force-kill, retry the mutation, restart this owner or claim external completion. Only after normal owned shutdown may another generation be assembled. Cross-border extension: accommodate the documented Lingxing catalog of over 300 tools with a bounded 512-tool per-service and per-selection ceiling; retain aggregate schema byte, depth, argument and result bounds. Never truncate a tool catalog into apparent complete readiness.
semantics.dataCapability: A separate generation-bound bearer is delivered only through a dedicated child launch environment to worker and the exact Runtime generation, with tool environment scrubbing. It never enters this control wire, responses, metadata, history, persistence or logs. Authenticated data requests still need an exact live bound lease and qualified tool approval. The initialize gatewayUrl is http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp; derive a lease route by appending /<capabilityRef>. The non-secret path only selects a lease; it is never sufficient authentication.
semantics.pendingCall: In v2 the paired Runtime privately registers its actual invocation before the native MCP decision. The legacy Gateway registers on tools/call. Reading a pending call or recording a decision never allocates a callRef. Verify process/context/turn/selection, exact installation revision and generation, supported tool and frozen arguments. The Runtime decides approval. The Host binds that decision to the call. The Worker consumes the matching single-use admission. Gateway elicitation metadata is exactly the ElicitationMetadata source projection (yijieMarketCallRef/yijieKind); fixed upstream MCP envelope remains external authority. New web 0.3 opt-in pairs webRetrievalVersion and mcpToolTimeoutMs=60000 on prepare before Runtime submission. Worker freezes prepare monotonic +60000 as conservative outer deadline, never renews it. Default tools keep previous deadlines; new body/Pro use decision D-35000-2000 and execution D. Approved must not expire at decision cutoff. Each v2 call carries its own post-policy dispatch receipt, including calls admitted by a remembered native decision.
semantics.shutdown: First stop admission and revoke/wake pending work. Shutdown acknowledgement is stopping, not external completion. EOF normally tears down transport and child resources. A typed capacity_exceeded response to Revoke/Shutdown requires the Host gate-held normal EOF retirement defined by capacity semantics; return the original safe code and separately wait for normal exit/STOP_PENDING. An unconfirmed external result stays unknown. Never force-kill or silently recreate a stopped owner.
semantics.unknownOutcome: A timeout does not prove rejection or execution. Read original lease/call/Host Turn operation before another action. Never automatically repeat external tools/call, especially writes. Broker restart invalidates old memory capabilities and cannot reconstruct approval from history.
semantics.qualification: Initialize externalCallsEnabled reports network assembly, not an execution grant. Status-only remains no-I/O; qualification profiles cannot contact providers. The retained tushare-daily-v1 strategy requires exact reviewed upstream daily schema and normalized arguments/results. Owner approved generic-mcp-v1 on 2026-10-08: fixed catalog services may discover complete bounded tool schemas during explicit connection, freeze definitions and exact ProviderBindings in live capabilities, and validate every call. Every admitted tool delegates its approval to the paired yijie-Codex Runtime. Risk and provider annotations describe the operation; neither grants permission nor selects a second reviewer. Every selected binding must resolve; expose no unselected tools or silently truncated catalog. Native explicit Enable, current scope/epoch/ref/generation/credentialRef, and the exact call-specific native decision are independent requirements. Prepare uses retained current client/schema facts, never history or new per-turn probes. Fresh Native permission polling observes existing capability without network, and never extends pending OAuth attempts or original turn/call deadlines. Changed credential or binding, closed backend, revoked authority or owner exit invalidates admission. FEAT-162 kimi-web uses the model-key source defined by kimiModelCredential. Native built-in default desired intent or explicit restore prepares canonical local web-retrieval descriptors without /models or remote tools/list. Local connected/qualified means invocation support, not supplier authentication, entitlement, balance or retrieval. Task selection, native approval policy and no automatic business retry remain mandatory. A paired nativeDispatchVersion=2 lease registers the exact invocation on the private owner channel. Only a genuine native allow and a matching single-use registration can dispatch its tools/call. Earlier recorded choices do not authorize a different request.
semantics.gatewayOutcome: Gateway keeps the existing MCP CallToolResult error shape: isError=true and bounded fixed text content, not a new structured error DTO. Choose gateway_errors using the actual call admission state and whether backend dispatch has begun, captured together under the Broker lock. ApprovalInvalid is not user rejection. Only the authoritative pre-consumption rejected/cancelled/expired/revoked cases may assert no provider request was sent. Consumed only spends one approval; later failure does not prove that nothing was sent or that execution occurred. Do not change consumed to a pre-dispatch terminal state, synthesize an empty successful result, suggest automatic/paid retries, or reinterpret OAuth authorization_rejected as tool approval rejection. Terminal market-turn admission failures carry a stable reason, retryable=false and retryScope=market_turn. No further market tool, parameter variant or quota probe may be attempted in that turn. An individual approval timeout and an unverified dispatched result are not turn-terminal.
semantics.kimiModelCredential: Local product assembly only: the Native-owned Host may give its existing Kimi model-key snapshot to the one owned Connectors worker through anonymous inherited FD 3, announced only as YIJIE_MARKET_KIMI_MODEL_KEY_FD=3. The private stream starts with yijie-kimi-model-key-v1 followed by LF and then at most 16384 UTF-8 key bytes and a final LF before EOF (required to reject incomplete writes). No JSONL/public/native protocol carries secrets. No raw key in argv/env, no source path or second persistent secret. Worker consumes and closes the descriptor before starting threads or provider children and removes the non-secret FD hint. Status-only/qualification modes never consume it. Missing/invalid source disables only Kimi configuration with not_configured. Key updates use the existing normal Host restart; each generation shares one model/connector snapshot, and old admission is revoked on normal exit. Native prepares this built-in automatically with existing Enable/Probe control (no HTTP); local prepared state requires exact current scope/generation/credentialRef. Legacy Configure is local-only and unqualified. Neither readiness nor default desired intent bypasses task selection or per-call ask.
semantics.resultCorrelation: The Gateway attaches bounded receipt metadata after supplier sanitization. A pre-dispatch denial gets its acknowledged private decision receipt in the failed native Item. Capture a read-only receipt for each registered call from the existing CallRecord; store approvalRef with the accepted decide_call identity, never reconstruct decisions from text. Preserve existing content/structuredContent/isError. Normal success, failure and denied-call results share this wrapper. No registered call or no returned result means no invented link. The containing native MCP Item supplies nativeItemId. Validate thread/turn/tool and original submission/selection before projecting a link; unknown or invalid metadata leaves native facts readable and unlinked. A receipt is never authority and cannot resume or repeat a call. Code Mode can expose metadata; it contains only non-secret correlation. 64 KiB provider results plus at most 4 KiB metadata fit the 72 KiB envelope, below native 1 MiB event truncation.

args_digest.encoding: Rust serde_json::to_vec of the exact frozen Option<Map<String, Value>>; absent arguments encodes null, present empty object encodes {}; UTF-8, lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 over domain bytes then encoded bytes
args_digest.ordering: Pinned serde_json without preserve_order uses sorted object keys; Host never re-serializes or recomputes this digest
args_digest.numbers: Only finite JSON numbers representable by pinned serde_json Value; no NaN/infinity, no post-registration coercion
args_digest.freeze: Schema validation and any qualified defaults happen before freezing; final call uses that same frozen parsed value. Any later argument change requires a new actual call record and approval. Digest is unkeyed identity, not authentication or cross-language canonicalization

ownerRejected.message: 用户已拒绝本次连接器调用，本次外部请求未发送。不会自动重试。
ownerRejected.when: Only a matching actual call with an authoritative owner reject decision and Broker CallState rejected, before approval consumption and before backend dispatch. ApprovalInvalid alone is insufficient.

admissionStopped.message: 本次连接器调用在进入外部执行前已停止，外部请求未发送。不会自动重试。
admissionStopped.when: Only a known pre-consumption cancelled, expired or revoked actual call with backend dispatch not begun. Do not guess that the user rejected it or infer a specific stop reason from ApprovalInvalid.

executionUnverified.message: 本次连接器调用未取得可验证的结果，无法确认外部请求是否已发送或完成。不能据此判断没有数据或已执行；不会自动重试。
executionUnverified.when: Any backend-dispatch error including cancellation, timeout, transport error or unsupported result remains unknown unless separate trusted execution evidence proves otherwise. Also use this conservative projection when pre-admission state cannot be established. Never reinterpret consumed as sent or successful.

leaseExpired.message: 本轮市场连接器授权已到期，外部请求未发送。本轮请停止调用所有市场工具，包括更换参数、工具或查询额度。请向用户说明原因，并用已有结果继续。
leaseExpired.when: The owned turn lease has expired before dispatch.

leaseRevoked.message: 本轮市场连接器授权已撤销，外部请求未发送。本轮请停止调用所有市场工具，包括更换参数、工具或查询额度。请向用户说明原因，并用已有结果继续。
leaseRevoked.when: The owned lease was revoked by the owner, including a selection or authorization change.

approvalExpired.message: 本次市场工具的单次审批已到期，外部请求未发送。请告知用户，本次操作需重新批准，请勿自行重试。
approvalExpired.when: The registered call expired before approval consumption while its turn lease remains live.
